description: Turn a link the user shared (Instagram post/reel, TikTok, YouTube video, article or web page) into content for the user: a single post (their own image, never the creator's media), a short video script they film on their phone via a teleprompter link, or an Instagram carousel. The link is read first — metadata, transcript, what it shows — which can take up to a minute for a long video. The result lands in the user's todo list for review.

context.description: What the user said alongside the link — why they like it, the angle, a product to feature

format.description: post = one social post, script = phone-filmed video with teleprompter, carousel = Instagram slide deck

platform.description: Post only: which platform to write for (default facebook)

scheduledFor.description: ISO date to schedule the post or carousel for

url.description: The full link, starting with http(s)://

name: create_from_link
title: Create From Link
